correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive standard-library programs independently represent the underlying graph via duad/syntheme incidence and via the symplectic W(2) generalized quadrangle. Both enumerate exactly 288 matchings, 1,440 legitimate 8-cycle flips, degree ten, all-source BFS profiles 144 copies of (1,10,45,97,96,37,2) and 144 copies of (1,10,42,97,101,37), radius five, diameter six, and 4,320 squares. The symplectic program independently enumerates zero 4- and 6-cycles, 90 eight-cycles, and exactly 32 alternating matchings on each eight-cycle. The duad program proves the four-coordinate adjacency criterion using exclusion of four-cycles and verifies S6 orbits and parity signs. All finite domains are exhaustively generated by recursive backtracking; results do not extrapolate beyond this specific finite graph.

value.rationale: The first possible local matching exchange on the unique cubic girth-eight cage induces a connected state graph, a genuinely sharp boundary not implied by unrestricted alternating-cycle reachability. Its 10-regular 288-state dynamics have an exact diameter and radial partition into two non-equivalent symmetry orbits with differing eccentricity, exposing a non-vertex-transitive reconfiguration graph over a highly vertex-transitive base. These are natural exact reconfiguration invariants rather than an arbitrary parameter slice; no general-family extension is claimed.
